item.title: Tehran orders Swedish diplomat to leave Iran within 48 hours
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran has rejected Sweden’s allegations against the Islamic Republic and ordered a Swedish diplomat in Tehran to leave the country within 48 hours in response to Stockholm’s decision to prevent an Iranian diplomat from continuing his duties in Sweden.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86266666/Tehran-orders-Swedish-diplomat-to-leave-Iran-within-48-hours

Tehran, IRNA – Iran has rejected Sweden’s allegations against the Islamic Republic and ordered a Swedish diplomat in Tehran to leave the country within 48 hours in response to Stockholm’s decision to prevent an Iranian diplomat from continuing his duties in Sweden.

item.title: Iran oil facilities damaged in war on track for restoration, minister says
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad says that the reconstruction of oil industry facilities damaged during the US-Israeli-imposed war was progressing well, with part of the lost capacity expected to return by the end of the current calendar year to late March.
